description: This Java source file defines Swagger API response schema classes for the Self Savings API in the Apache Fineract project. It contains nested classes decorated with Swagger annotations to describe the structure of responses related to self-savings accounts, transactions, and charges.

classes.name: SelfSavingsApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: A container class for Swagger response schema classes related to Self Savings API

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsAccountsResponse
classes.description: Schema representation of the response for fetching self-savings accounts.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of a self-savings account with fields like id, code, description, and boolean flags.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsTimeline
classes.description: Represents the timeline data for savings account, specifically the submitted date.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsCurrency
classes.description: Represents currency details for a savings account, including code, name, symbol, and decimal places.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsInterestCompoundingPeriodType
classes.description: Represents interest compounding period type details.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsInterestPostingPeriodType
classes.description: Represents interest posting period type details.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsInterestCalculationType
classes.description: Represents the interest calculation type details.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsInterestCalculationDaysInYearType
classes.description: Represents the days-in-year type for interest calculation.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsSummary
classes.description: Summary of a savings account including currency info and account balance.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsAccountsAccountIdTransactionsTransactionIdResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response of a specific transaction in a savings account.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsTransactionType
classes.description: Details of a transaction type, such as withdrawal or interest posting.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsPaymentDetailData
classes.description: Payment details associated with a transaction, including payment type.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsAccountsAccountIdChargesResponse
classes.description: Schema representing charges associated with a savings account.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsChargeTimeType
classes.description: Charge timing type, e.g., specified due date.

classes.name: GetSelfSavingsAccountsAccountIdChargesSavingsAccountChargeIdResponse
classes.description: Details for specific savings account charges.
